notes: RBox revision of transitivity: flips a property that holds (transitivity of 'is located in') to its opposite, as biology-replace-0009 does for 'is part of'. Migrated 2026-11-11 to the new layout. The statement was "'Is located in' is not transitive", whose negation question ("Is it false that ... is not transitive?") all 4 models missed as a double negative; "intransitive" keeps one negation and makes this a revision rather than the removal geography-delete-0011 makes. The direct question still asks "transitive?" (yes, then no). Both instances ask whether the conclusion follows, which is no under both readings of the edit (intransitive or merely not transitive); a "does that rule out" question would split those readings, so this record answers no twice and the topic's other RBox records balance it. Instances use places whose country is not a famous stored fact (Ambert, Kandy) instead of Lyon in Europe and Machu Picchu in South America. Side facts: the Amazon flowing into the Atlantic (missed by 1) and a false disjunct. Far changed from 'is a classmate of' (missed by 3) to 'is married to'. Locality references are the logical answers; the scoring gold is the model's own pre-edit answer.
